briefing: - Drupal缺失认证漏洞已入KEV，存在在野利用，须立即升级修复
- 勒索软件关联为0，重点防Drupal在野利用后投递勒索
- 批量高危RCE集中披露，多条CVSS 9.8以上且缺产品版本
- CVE-2026-138004达CVSS 10.0，命令注入，产品版本缺失需排查
- Drupal漏洞EPSS 8.4%且有3个PoC，优先于其他未利用高危项

items.title: Drupal核心关键功能缺失认证
items.title_zh: Drupal核心关键功能缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 远程未授权攻击者可访问缺失鉴权的关键功能路由,绕过访问控制并完全控制站点
items.action_zh: 立即升级Drupal核心至最新修复版本,并复核关键功能访问控制
items.repro_note: 未授权访问核心关键功能路由,定位缺失鉴权的控制器方法
items.impact_scope: 通用CMS核心,互联网站点广泛部署
items.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13.

items.title: VeraCrypt Linux命令注入
items.summary_zh: 本地同UID攻击者借已提权的CoreService会话,注入VirtualDevice值执行任意命令
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级到1.26.30,并收紧CoreService会话授权
items.repro_note: 本地同UID进程在已提权CoreService会话中传入恶意VirtualDevice
items.impact_scope: 本地加密工具,同机多用户场景
items.description: VeraCrypt before 1.26.30 on Linux contains a command injection vulnerability in CoreUnix::CheckFilesystem that allows a local attacker with same-UID access and an active elevated CoreService session to execute arbitrary commands by injecting an unsanitized VirtualDevice value into a shell command string. Attackers can reopen the request pipe through /proc/<pid>/fd/<n> and supply a crafted VirtualDevice value such as /dev/null; <command> to achieve arbitrary command execution as root.

items.title: Adobe恶意文件致代码执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造恶意文件诱导用户打开,在外部条件满足时执行任意代码
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 关注Adobe公告,升级受影响产品至最新版本
items.repro_note: 需用户打开构造的恶意文件,且依赖额外前置条件
items.impact_scope: Adobe文档类产品,终端用户
items.description: A code injection vulnerability exists in Epiphany when the user invokes form autofill from the context menu on a page containing a malicious HTML form.

items.title: Epiphany扩展安装路径穿越
items.summary_zh: 诱导用户安装恶意.xpi扩展,可覆盖.bashrc等用户可写文件实现持久化
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Epiphany至修复版本,不安装来源不明的.xpi扩展
items.repro_note: 安装含../条目的恶意.xpi,覆盖~/.bashrc等文件
items.impact_scope: 桌面浏览器,用户态任意文件覆盖
items.description: A path traversal (ZIP slip) vulnerability exists in Epiphany when installing WebExtension packages from .xpi files. A malicious .xpi file can therefore overwrite arbitrary files writable by the user running Epiphany, such as ~/.bashrc, ~/.config/autostart/*.desktop, or ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.

items.title: TRENDnet路由器UPnP命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向UPnP的/soap.cgi接口service参数注入命令,以系统权限执行
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复,停用UPnP或限制/soap.cgi公网访问
items.repro_note: 向/soap.cgi的service参数注入命令,无需认证
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器,UPnP常暴露公网
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR and TEW-733GR 1.03B01. Affected is the function soapcgi_main of the file /soap.cgi of the component UPnP Igd Control Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument service leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: Mitel OpenScape命令注入
items.summary_zh: 可访问Platform组件的攻击者利用参数未过滤注入命令,以系统权限执行
items.action_zh: 升级OpenScape 4000至厂商修复版本,限制管理面访问
items.repro_note: 访问Platform组件接口,构造未过滤参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: 企业语音平台,内网核心通信
items.description: A vulnerability in the Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager could allow an attacker to conduct a command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system.

items.title: WordPress文件上传插件路径穿越
items.title_zh: WordPress文件上传插件路径穿越
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向插件上传功能传入路径参数穿越目录,读取或写入站点任意文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级wp-file-upload插件至最新修复版本
items.impact_scope: WordPress插件,站点文件泄露
items.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Nickboss WordPress File Upload wp-file-upload allows Path Traversal.This issue affects WordPress File Upload: from n/a through 5.3.1.

items.title: Exploitation High
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·利用条件苛刻·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: Adobe(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Dreamweaver Desktop is affected by a Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control and requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file. Scope is changed.

items.title: 多租户平台任意用户会话伪造
items.title_zh: 多租户平台任意用户会话伪造
items.summary_zh: 远程未授权攻击者可伪造任意用户(含管理员)会话,跨租户读写企业数据
items.action_zh: 确认受影响产品并升级至官方修复版本,临时限制RPC暴露
items.repro_note: 需先确定受影响产品,伪造会话调用认证RPC方法
items.impact_scope: 多租户服务端,统一RPC入口
items.description: When the check passes, Ping stores an attacker-chosen session ID, user number and company in the server session store, and subsequent session validation accepts that session. An unauthenticated remote attacker can therefore create a valid session as any user, including administrators, in any company (tenant) hosted on the server and invoke authenticated RPC methods with that user's privileges, gaining read and write access to that company's data.

items.title: WPMasterToolKit插件代码注入
items.summary_zh: 具备插件配置权限的攻击者注入代码,在WordPress站点执行任意PHP代码
items.action_zh: 升级WPMasterToolKit至最新修复版本
items.impact_scope: WordPress插件,后台提权跳板
items.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Webdeclic WPMasterToolKit wpmastertoolkit allows Code Injection.This issue affects WPMasterToolKit: from n/a through 2.26.1.

items.title: Revertix插件反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造恶意序列化数据触发对象注入,进而接管WordPress站点
items.action_zh: 升级Revertix至1.0.3以上修复版本
items.impact_scope: WordPress备份插件,站点接管
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Nitramix Revertix – Backup, Migration, Staging & Clone revertix allows Object Injection.This issue affects Revertix – Backup, Migration, Staging & Clone: from n/a through 1.0.3.

items.title: ToolJet发布流程命令注入
items.summary_zh: 向仓库提交含命令的PR标题,在发布工作流中执行,污染构建产物
items.action_zh: 升级到3.21.96-LTS及以上
items.repro_note: fork仓库提交PR,在标题中注入shell命令触发工作流
items.impact_scope: 低代码平台CI流程,影响构建产物
items.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which interpolates the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Attackers can submit a pull request against a release branch with shell metacharacters in its title that, once merged, executes commands with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.

items.title: WebinarIgnition插件权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限或未授权用户可利用错误的权限分配获得管理员权限，进而完全控制WordPress站点
items.action_zh: 升级至4.28.1之后的修复版本，并排查异常高权限账户
items.impact_scope: WordPress营销插件，站点常暴露公网
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Tobias WebinarIgnition webinar-ignition allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects WebinarIgnition: from n/a through 4.28.1.

items.title: MemberPress插件权限提升
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用错误的权限分配提升为高权限账户，可接管安装了该Discord附加组件的站点
items.action_zh: 升级至1.1.5之后的修复版本，收紧注册与角色赋权逻辑
items.impact_scope: WordPress会员插件，站点常暴露公网
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in expresstechsoftware MemberPress Discord Addon expresstechsoftwares-memberpress-discord-add-on allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MemberPress Discord Addon: from n/a through 1.1.5.

items.title: Google应用集成反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者提交恶意序列化Java对象,在事件总线执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 平台已于2026-09-22修复,无需操作,核查实例版本
items.repro_note: 已认证调用eventbus接口,提交恶意序列化Java对象
items.impact_scope: GCP托管集成服务,云上流程
items.description: A Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the eventbus execution in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-09-22 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution using a crafted serialized Java object. This vulnerability was patched on 22 September 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: Vertex AI助手接口未授权访问
items.title_zh: Vertex AI助手接口未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者构造API请求即可列出、读取并发送他人会话消息，泄露云端对话数据
items.action_zh: 漏洞已由Google服务端修复，无需客户操作，确认实例版本日期
items.impact_scope: GCP托管云服务，已在服务端修复
items.description: A Missing Authorization vulnerability in the private console API in Google Cloud Vertex AI (Vertex AI Assistant) versions prior to 2026-04-13 on Google Cloud Platform allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to list, read, create, and send messages in other users' chat sessions using crafted API requests. This vulnerability was patched on 13 April 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: Amelia预约插件认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过身份伪造绕过认证冒充任意用户，可接管预约系统账户与客户敏感数据
items.action_zh: 升级至2.4.14之后的修复版本，核查异常登录与预约记录
items.impact_scope: WordPress预约插件，常暴露公网
items.description: Authentication Bypass by Spoofing vulnerability in TMS Amelia ameliabooking allows Identity Spoofing.This issue affects Amelia: from n/a through 2.4.14.

items.title: BIND后端notify配置破坏
items.summary_zh: 攻击者发送notify请求把根域加为从域,使后端配置失效,重启后需人工修复
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 关注BIND修复版本,限制notify来源并备份配置
items.repro_note: 发送notify请求注入根域为从域,重启后后端失效
items.impact_scope: DNS后端服务,内网解析设施
items.description: An attacker can send a notify request that causes the root zone to be added as a secondary domain to be added to the bind backend, but causes said backend to update its configuration to an invalid one, leading to the backend no longer able to run on the next restart, requiring manual operation to fix it. The general case of this problem was addressed by SA-2026-05, but the root zone was not handled correctly. This is now fixed.

items.title: 未授权 XSS
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a backend user who opens a crafted link while logged in to the backend in the same browser; the code runs with the privileges of that user and can use the backend session token contained in the same script to send requests to the backend.

items.title: SameSite 未授权 XSS
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a logged-in backend user who opens a crafted link in the same browser (the session cookie carries no SameSite attribute by default); the code runs with the privileges of that user and can use the backend token of the same page to send requests to the backend.

items.title: 未授权 XSS
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: The backend language switch action (quick_change_language) of the JTL-Shop administration backend is executed without a CSRF token check, and the supplied language value is neither validated against the installed backend languages nor encoded on output. An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a logged-in administrator who opens a crafted web page; the code can perform actions with the privileges of that administrator.

items.title: 未授权 内存破坏
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: A weakness has been identified in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. This impacts the function FUN_0040ed90 of the file wfadev.cgi of the component UPnP/WFA. This manipulation of the argument SOAPAction causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: WordPress MLA插件SQL盲注
items.summary_zh: 具备一定权限的攻击者向插件参数注入SQL,盲注读取数据库敏感数据
items.action_zh: 升级Media Library Assistant至最新修复版本
items.impact_scope: WordPress插件,数据库数据泄露
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in David Lingren Media LIbrary Assistant media-library-assistant allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Media LIbrary Assistant: from n/a through 3.43.

items.title: WooCommerce网关SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造过滤参数注入SQL,读取支付网关及订单相关数据库数据
items.action_zh: 升级cleverpay-gateway至1.8.4以上版本
items.impact_scope: WooCommerce支付插件,订单数据
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Hello Clever Pty Hello Clever Gateway for WooCommerce cleverpay-gateway allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Hello Clever Gateway for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.8.4.

items.title: Video Share VOD路径穿越
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造路径参数穿越目录,读取站点服务器上的任意文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级Video Share VOD至3.15.1以上版本
items.impact_scope: WordPress视频插件,服务器文件
items.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in VideoWhisper.com Video Share VOD video-share-vod allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Video Share VOD: from n/a through 3.15.1.

items.title: theMarketer任意文件上传
items.summary_zh: 攻击者绕过类型校验上传危险文件,可在站点服务器执行恶意代码
items.action_zh: 升级theMarketer至1.5.9以上版本
items.impact_scope: WordPress主题/插件,站点失陷
items.description: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability in theMarketer theMarketer themarketer allows Using Malicious Files.This issue affects theMarketer: from n/a through 1.5.9.

items.title: CWE-73
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.description: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in integration nodes that build API request paths from unencoded record, table, or resource ID parameters. Attackers can supply relative path segments through untrusted input such as webhook bodies to read, modify, or delete unintended resources using the node's stored credential.

items.title: Seraphinite加速器路径穿越
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造.../...//路径参数绕过目录限制,读取站点目录外文件
items.action_zh: 升级Seraphinite Accelerator至2.31.3以上
items.impact_scope: WordPress缓存插件,任意文件读取
items.description: Path Traversal: '.../...//' vulnerability in Seraphinite Solutions Seraphinite Accelerator seraphinite-accelerator allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Seraphinite Accelerator: from n/a through 2.31.3.

items.title: Apigee Edge报表SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者构造报表过滤条件注入SQL,越权读取底层数据库数据
items.repro_note: 已认证调用收益报表API,构造过滤条件注入SQL
items.impact_scope: 云API管理平台,租户数据
items.description: A SQL Injection vulnerability in the Revenue Reports API in Google Cloud Apigee Edge Monetization versions prior to 2026-07-16 (Public Cloud) and OPDK 4.54.00 (Private Cloud) on Apigee Edge Public Cloud and Apigee Edge for Private Cloud (OPDK) allows an authenticated attacker to gain unauthorized read access to the underlying database using crafted report filtering criteria. This vulnerability was patched on 16 July 2026 in Apigee Edge Public Cloud and in OPDK version 4.54.00.

items.title: WP ERP插件权限提升
items.summary_zh: 已注册低权限用户可借错误权限分配提权为管理员，进而控制企业ERP数据与站点
items.action_zh: 升级至2.0.0之后的修复版本，审计现有用户角色
items.impact_scope: WordPress企业插件，内网部署常见
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in weDevs WP ERP erp allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects WP ERP: from n/a through 2.0.0.

items.title: Pydantic Deep应用未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可枚举会话、读取事件日志与工作区文件，并驱动研究代理删除会话
items.action_zh: 升级至0.4.0及以上，避免服务绑定0.0.0.0并前置认证网关
items.repro_note: 直接访问HTTP路由与/ws/chat，前提是服务监听全网卡
items.impact_scope: 开发研究类FastAPI服务，多绑全网卡
items.description: Pydantic Deep 0.2.18 before 0.4.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the bundled DeepResearch FastAPI app that exposes HTTP routes and the /ws/chat WebSocket. Remote attackers reaching the server bound to all interfaces can enumerate sessions, read event logs and workspace files, drive the research agent, and delete sessions.

items.title: POSTAL 2工坊模组沙箱逃逸
items.summary_zh: 恶意Steam工坊模组经ConsoleCommand调用ShellExecuteW，以玩家权限执行任意命令
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至build 26810491之后版本，勿加载来源不明模组
items.repro_note: 在工坊可预测路径放置批处理文件，经模组ConsoleCommand触发
items.impact_scope: 单机游戏客户端，影响玩家本机
items.description: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.

items.title: Dell SCG虚拟版本地命令注入
items.title_zh: Dell SCG虚拟版本地命令注入
items.summary_zh: 本地未认证攻击者可注入OS命令执行脚本，进而提权并控制网关设备
items.action_zh: 升级至5.36.00.16及以上版本，限制本地登录权限
items.repro_note: 需本地访问设备，向存在命令拼接的接口参数注入指令
items.impact_scope: 运维网关设备，多为内网部署
items.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An unauthenticated local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Script injection.

items.title: Leo编辑器反序列化代码执行
items.title_zh: Leo编辑器反序列化代码执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造含pickle载荷的.leo大纲，受害者打开即以其权限执行任意代码
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至6.8.10之后版本，不打开来源不明的大纲文件
items.repro_note: 在<t>/<v>元素属性植入__reduce__载荷，打开文件触发
items.impact_scope: 桌面编辑器客户端，需用户打开文件
items.description: Leo through 6.8.10 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by embedding pickled data in unknown XML attributes of .leo outlines. Attackers can place a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a <t> or <v> element attribute that resolveUa passes to pickle.loads, executing code with user privileges when the outline is opened.

items.title: HCIPy反序列化代码执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者提供恶意.pkl文件，受害者调用读取函数时即以其本地权限执行代码
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至0.7.1之后版本，禁止加载不可信pkl文件
items.impact_scope: 科研Python库，本地加载文件场景
items.description: HCIPy through 0.7.1 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .pkl files to read_field, read_grid or read_mode_basis. Because hcipy/util/io.py selects pickle by file extension and calls pickle.load, a __reduce__ gadget in a pupil, apodizer, PSF or mode-basis file runs code with the user's privileges.

items.title: Detoxify 反序列化(RCE)

items.description: A flaw was found in GIMP. The Levels configuration setter does not validate the channel enum before using it to index fixed-size per-channel arrays.
